component.name: Come Back Window
component.summary: Windows-style window shortcuts for KDE Plasma 6

description.p: Come Back Window brings the window behaviour Windows users are used to to KDE Plasma 6 on Wayland: show desktop, minimize, maximize, close, minimize all others and restore them.

ul.li: Show desktop / restore with Meta+D and Meta+M
Thin Show Desktop strip at the bottom-right corner of the screen
Aero Peek: windows fade while the pointer rests on the strip
Aero Shake: shake a window to minimize the others
Tray menu with settings and a first-run wizard
